content.comment_body: Hello, I purchased a [company_name] [product_name] [article_no] along with [product_name] [version_no] [article_no] in April 2015 and bought a license at that time. Previously, I ran the software smoothly on my older Mac. However, after upgrading to a newer Mac (since my previous one no longer starts), and now using the latest OS Sonoma, installation has become problematic. I've tried installing both the upgrades and full packages, but none have worked on Sonoma or the previous OS. I downloaded the installer without Java and extracted it using Stuffit Expander. I also enabled installation in the security settings since it was initially blocked, but that's not the root cause. When attempting to run the setup, I receive a "Setup cannot be opened" message. Any assistance would be greatly appreciated, thank you. Best regards, [user_name]

Hello again, The issue is resolved! I found a solution in another post at [url], where another user fixed the problem by using a different unpacking software. It turns out Stuffit Expander was the source of the issue. //[user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: The user had trouble installing [product_name] [version_no] on MacOS Sonoma, specifically due to compatibility problems with Stuffit Expander when unpacking the installer. Adjusting security settings did not resolve the issue, but switching to a different unpacking tool resolved the installation problem, highlighting the importance of choosing compatible unpacking software on MacOS.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects to install and use [product_name] [version_no] on the latest MacOS smoothly, without errors during installation, regardless of which unpacking utility is used.
